title: Persistence of True Cells on the Last Tape
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine with $K+1$ work tapes, and suppose that every transition either leaves the cell scanned by the last work tape unchanged or writes true there. Starting from the initial configuration on any input, every cell of the last work tape is blank or contains true at every time. Moreover, once a cell contains true, it continues to contain true at every later time.
hypotheses_covered: Every transition leaves the scanned cell of the last tape unchanged or writes true there.
The run starts from the machine's initial configuration on an arbitrary input.
The time indices are natural numbers, and the later time is at least the earlier time.
